description: This file contains verification functions for the etcd backend, including validation of function call contexts, backend consistency checks, and internal utility functions for verifying data integrity between transactions.

methods.name: ValidateCalledInsideApply
methods.description: Validates that the function is called inside an apply context, panics if called outside.

methods.name: ValidateCalledOutSideApply
methods.description: Validates that the function is called outside an apply context, panics if called inside.

methods.name: ValidateCalledInsideUnittest
methods.description: Validates that the function is called within a unit test context, fatals if outside.

methods.name: verifyLockEnabled
methods.description: Checks if verification is enabled for lock verification type.

methods.name: insideApply
methods.description: Determines if the current call stack indicates an apply context.

methods.name: insideUnittest
methods.description: Determines if the current call stack indicates a unit test context.

methods.name: VerifyBackendConsistency
methods.description: Verifies that data in ReadTx and BatchTx are consistent for given buckets.

methods.name: unsafeVerifyTxConsistency
methods.description: Performs an internal consistency check between write and read transactions for a bucket.
